image.alt: Black and white chess pieces on a board

firstPlayerRule: White, the player with the light-colored pieces, makes the first move. Black moves next, and the players then alternate turns.
clarifications: This instruction identifies the starting color after colors have been assigned; the cited Laws do not provide a universal method for choosing who receives White.
For clocked competitive play, Article 6.6 says to start White's clock at the scheduled beginning.

internalEvidence:
Read the publisher-hosted English HTML in context: Introduction 0.1 identifies over-the-board scope and effective date; Article 1.2 assigns the opening move to White; Article 2 establishes standard setup; Article 6.6 corroborates the clock start. No color-allocation procedure is inferred. This draft is limited to standard chess and is not a general variant or tournament pairing answer.
